name: Vectorization
description: Transform scalar loop iterations into vector operations by promoting innermost loops to operate on vector lanes, enabling AVX2 SIMD execution. This action applies MLIR's linalg vectorization and succeeds only when the operation has been appropriately tiled to produce hardware-realistic vector sizes (typically requires prior tiling to small tile sizes like 2×2 or 4×4 for f64, or 4×4 to 8×8 for f32).

parameters.name: vectorize
parameters.description: Whether to apply vectorization (must be true for action to execute)
